messages:
Maria L.: quick review request for 'recipient bubble' in alert preview. idea: compact chips for recipients that expand to full list. link to mock: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/recipient-bubble.png
Jon (PM): love compactness, but worried people miss who exactly gets pinged during oncall rotations. need explicit affordance to view full resolved endpoints.
Priya (Design): propose show up to 2 chips then a "+N recipients" button that opens inline expanded list. copy for button: '+2 more recipients' (not just '+2').
Ravi (Frontend): we'll lazy-load the resolved recipients when panel opens and show a spinner for expansion. also keyboard: the '+N' must be focusable and toggle the expanded list.
Ellie (Accessibility): ensure expanded state is announced via aria-live and that the collapsed button has aria-expanded. prepend suppression state to the region (e.g. '(Suppressed)') for SR users. color alone cannot convey suppression.
Maria L.: copy tweak: change header from 'Notify when threshold is met' to 'Alert when threshold is reached' across templates.
Priya (Design): suppression pill copy: 'Suppressed — maintenance until Jun 10, 15:00 UTC' instead of just 'Suppressed'. makes intent clearer.
Ravi (Frontend): backend note: include routing rule names in the preview payload so tooltip can show 'mapped by <rule>'. infra-bot: created ticket INF-4523 for resolved recipients API.
Jon (PM): good. decisions: 1) compact chips + '+N more recipients' focusable 2) expanded list announced via aria-live 3) suppression inline with reason + end time 4) lazy-load recipients with spinner 5) copy change to 'Alert when threshold is reached'. Priya will update figma, Ellie will add a11y checklist, Ravi will add dev story.
Maria L.: thanks all — drop links to figma + tickets and i'll close this thread. :tada:
